mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 9.5% signals severe labor market distress and weak economic growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 9.5%), or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During post-recession recovery phases, stable low inflation (CPIAUCSL below 1.5% annualized) signals sustainable growth without inflationary pressures, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of recovery periods with CPIAUCSL < 1.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening manufacturing activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO's monthly increase fails to predict positive returns in more than 40% of cases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 500 thousand units signals housing market weakness and reduced consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances (HOUST < 500), or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates labor market deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In early recovery phases (annualized GDP growth above 1%), rising GDP (GDPC1) signals expanding economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of early recovery periods with GDPC1 growth > 1%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.
